title: Overview
description: The whole picture in one payload: what the web view renders.

can_create_issues.description:
Whether "New issue here…" can create an issue: the GitHub App's installation has
Issues: write, or the server runs on the local stand-in (ADR 0025).

comment_approvals_until.description:
The cutover (`RUBATO_COMMENT_APPROVALS_UNTIL`, ADR 0054), when one is configured: plans are
approved in Rubato, and an `Approved:` comment posted at or after it does not count. Absent
before the cutover is set, and from an older server: *Accept plan* as before.

companion_silent_secs.description:
The companion stale threshold N in seconds, from the server's config
(`RUBATO_COMPANION_SILENT_SECS`). A companion lane's freshness bar drains over it, and
`CompanionSilent` fires past it (#105). An older server's overview reads as 600.

draft.description: The shared draft of the map and its proposal (ADR 0018). Never an input to progress.

layout.description:
Where the team has put each part (ADR 0016). Parts without a position are laid out
automatically. Never an input to progress.

pulls.description: Open pull requests per map repo (ADR 0034). Never an input to progress.

queue.description:
What each developer intends to run on their companions, lane by lane (ADR 0020).
Never an input to progress.

repos.description: One row per repo the map names, plus repos of tracked work outside the map.

traffic.description:
Observed calls per seam from the latest traffic report (ADR 0039). Absent from an older
server: not configured. Never an input to progress.

unpinned_sessions.description: Sessions not attached to any issue (branch outside the convention).

workspace.description: The workspace this overview is of (ADR 0049). An older server's overview reads as `default`.

workspaces.description: Every configured workspace, in switcher order. Empty from an older server.

AffectedPart.description: One row of the affected-parts table. This is what paints the map.

seams.description: Seam ids this change touches. Each needs an O-row.

ApprovalRecord.description:
A person's approval of a plan (ADR 0054): an issue comment whose first line is
`Approved: plan <sha>` or `Approved: plan <sha> on <branch>` (ADR 0027), from a trusted
author only; or an approval given in Rubato, with its `approval_id` and no comment.

approval_id.description: The `rubato_approvals` row, for an approval given in Rubato.

branch.description: The branch the approval names; else the branch Rubato reads the plan from.

bundle_hash.description: The bundle an approval given in Rubato covers (the plan, its design note, its ADRs).

comment_id.description: The comment's id, for a comment approval.

sha.description:
The plan hash approved (checkboxes cleared, git blob sha). Absent when the comment names
none: the approval then shows as "version not named".

source.description: Absent for a comment, which is all an approval was before ADR 0054.

url.description: The comment's URL; empty for an approval given in Rubato.

oneOf.description:
An `Approved:` comment on the issue (ADR 0027). Counted only when posted before the
cutover, `RUBATO_COMMENT_APPROVALS_UNTIL`.
An approval given in Rubato, recorded in `rubato_approvals`.

ApprovalState.description: The newest counted approval of an issue's plan, and whether it is of the current version.

current_sha.description: The hash of the plan compared with, when there is one.

ApprovalVersion.description: How an approval relates to the plan Rubato holds now.

oneOf.description: The approved hash is the plan's hash now.
The plan changed after the approval (finding `ApprovalStale`).
The comment names no hash.
No plan file to compare with on that branch.

The approval names the plan as it is now, but the plan does not fit the map, so the
approval does not count (ADR 0029, finding `ApprovedWithoutFit`).

Assumption.description: A decision the plan had to make that nothing settled.

oneOf.description: Inside one node: assumed and labelled.
On a seam: blocks until a human answers.

Backlog.description: Every open issue of the map's repos that is not tracked yet, and how fresh each listing is.

repos.description: One entry per repo the map names, listed or not.

BacklogRepo.description: How fresh one repo's listing is. The trust check for the backlog.

error.description: Why the latest listing failed. Absent when it succeeded.

listed_at.description: The last good listing. Absent until the first one.

truncated.description: The listing was cut at the server's cap.

BlockCause.description:
Which hook blocked a session (ADR 0043): the current cause of the current status, set with
a *blocked* status and cleared by the next hook that implies a status.

oneOf.description: `Notification` with `permission_prompt`: waiting for a permission, mid-turn.
`Notification` with `idle_prompt`: waiting for input after the turn ended.
`StopFailure`: the turn failed, mid-turn.
No checks configured.

ClientKind.description: What kind of client a companion is (ADR 0062). Every client has one owner and never approves.

oneOf.description: Sessions in the developer's tmux, input pasted into the pane.
No terminal: each turn is a `claude -p` child process the companion holds.

ConnectedRepo.description:
One repo the map names, and what Rubato sees of it: whether the App covers it, and its open
issues, plans and sessions. A repo outside the map with tracked work appears with
`in_map: false`.

covered.description: The App installation covers it (ADR 0022). False also when coverage is not known yet.

open_issues.description: Open issues in the latest listing.

open_pulls.description: Open pull requests from its own branches in the latest listing (ADR 0034).

plans.description: Tracked issues with a plan file.

sessions.description: Live sessions tied to an issue of this repo.

unattributed.description: Live sessions in this repo with no issue.

DataModel.description:
One row of the plan's Data models table (ADR 0031): a model on the part that owns it, and the
seam it travels over, if any.

crosses.description: Seam id the model crosses. Must be touched in Affected parts.

model.description: The model's name or names, as written, backticks removed.

part.description: Node id of the part that owns the model. Must be in Affected parts.

DecisionRecord.description: A decision recorded as an issue comment with the `Decision:` template (ADR 0014).

DiscrepancyKey.description: What a person can dismiss on the overlay (ADR 0060).

oneOf.description: A ghost part, and with it every edge to or from it.
An observed edge no seam declares, between parts or with a ghost end.
A declared seam that carried no calls.

DraftOp.description: An operation in the draft, with who made it and when.

seq.description: Its place in the draft; also its name in `DELETE /api/map/draft/ops/{seq}`.

stale.description:
Why the operation no longer applies to the map as it is now (with the operations before
it). It is skipped in the preview, and the draft cannot be proposed until it is removed.

DraftSummary.description: A draft as the overview carries it, per issue: its newest settled revision.

imported_from.description: The branch an imported plan was found on (ADR 0058).

live.description:
The owner's launched session for this branch is live: the draft is being worked on.
Otherwise it is parked. Derived on each overview build.

original_author.description: Who last committed the imported plan file, kept with the draft the importer owns.

owner.description: The paired user whose launch first mirrored to this branch.

parse_error.description: Why the plan in that revision does not parse, when it does not.

plan_sha.description: The approval hash of the plan in that revision (ADR 0054).

Finding.description: Map versus territory, and plans that disagree with the map. Shown, never suppressed.

oneOf.description: A plan names ids the map does not declare.
Two or more open plans touch the same seam.

Another person's launched session wrote a plan bundle on a branch whose draft someone
else owns; it was not stored (ADR 0053). Taking a draft over is Import.

The plan on the branch carries an approval record Rubato did not make, or one that differs
from its own, or a hash that is not the approved one (ADR 0054, ADR 0055). No link
comment is posted for it.

The link comment's outcome is unknown and the comments pass has not found it for 30
minutes; a person may post it again (ADR 0055).
Rubato holds no usable token for the approver, so the link comment waits (ADR 0055).

The approval covers ADRs that live in the map repo, which this repo's handoff could not
accept (ADR 0055, Q12).
A plan file exists but does not parse.
A session was launched against a different map version than the server holds.

The GitHub App installation does not cover a repo the map or a tracked issue names, so
its branches, plans and pull requests cannot be read (ADR 0022).
A plan's flow names a seam that does not join the flow's two parts (ADR 0021).
The plan was approved, then changed: the approval names an earlier version (ADR 0027).

An approval names the current plan, but the plan does not fit the map, so it does not
count (ADR 0029).

An `Approved:` comment posted at or after the cutover: not counted, since plans are
approved in Rubato (ADR 0054).

A live session Rubato cannot tie to an issue: its branch is not `issue/<n>-…`, or its
repo is unknown.

Map versus territory (ADR 0039): a declared seam with no calls in the window of a fresh
report, though both its parts show traffic elsewhere in it.

Map versus territory (ADR 0039): calls between two parts no seam joins, from a fresh
report. `from` calls `to`.

Map versus territory (ADR 0059): a service in a fresh report, emitting a namespace, that
no part names. A person may take it into the map draft or dismiss it (plan #140).

Two workspaces whose maps name a repo give it different plan paths (ADR 0045). The
first in config order is used.

An id in a repo shared by two workspaces names parts with different repos in their maps
(ADR 0045): it may mean two things. Shown, never refused.

FitReason.description: Why a plan does not fit the map (ADR 0029). Each one alone makes `PlanFit::fits` false.

oneOf.description: The plan file does not parse.
Node or seam ids the map does not declare.
A flow's seam does not join the flow's two parts.
A seam in Affected parts with no O-row.
A data model on a part that is not a row of Affected parts (ADR 0031).
A data model crossing a seam no row of Affected parts touches (ADR 0031).

Flow.description:
One thing crossing a seam in one direction. `from` and `to` are the seam's two nodes, in
either order.

carries.description: What it carries: a type, a message, a command.

FlowKind.description: Data moves; control tells the other side to do something.

GhostEdge.description: Calls with a ghost at one end or both. `from` calls `to`.

GhostPart.description:
A service seen in a fresh report, emitting a namespace, that no part names: drawn on the
overlay until a person takes it into the map draft (plan #140). Never a map part.

calls_in.description: Calls it received in the window.

IssueSummary.description: Everything the map view needs about one issue.

approval.description:
The newest approval a member posted, and whether it is of the plan as it is now. A
badge, not a progress state.

draft.description:
The issue's plan draft in Rubato, its newest settled revision (ADR 0053). Absent when the
issue has none.

fit.description: Where the plan fits the map, and whether it does (ADR 0029). Absent without a plan file.

fits_in.description:
Names of the workspaces whose map the plan fits (ADR 0045). The approval counts when this
is not empty; in a workspace not named here the issue reads "counts in <name>".

outside_rubato.description:
The plan on the issue's branch was written outside Rubato (ADR 0058): the branch has no
draft and no approval counts. It is shown with its fit, cannot be approved as it stands,
and can be imported. Only once the cutover is set; before it, plans are approved by comment.

pinned_in.description: Names of the other workspaces where the issue is pinned (ADR 0047): "pinned in <name>".

plan_sha.description:
The plan's approval hash as Rubato read it (ADR 0027): what *Accept plan* approves and
what `Approved: plan <sha>` names.

review.description: The newest design review a member posted (ADR 0027).

spend_history.description:
Spend over time, oldest first, at most 24 points: each the issue's total over every
session it has had, ended ones included (ADR 0037). Not an input to progress.

MapDraft.description: The draft as every browser sees it.

can_restore.description: A discarded draft can still be brought back (until the next operation is written).

preview.description: The map with every operation that applies. Absent when the draft is empty.

MapLayout.description:
Positions by part id, for the flat map (ADR 0016) and for the By repo grouping (ADR 0068).
In the overview it is the whole stored layout; as the body of `PUT /api/layout` it holds only
what moved; as the answer of `DELETE /api/layout` or `DELETE /api/layout/grouped` it is what
was removed, so a `PUT` of it undoes the removal.

boxes.description: The By repo grouping: each repo box's top-left on the canvas, by `owner/name`.

grouped.description:
The By repo grouping: each part's top-left relative to its repo's box, or on the canvas
for a part with no repo. Never read for the flat map, never written by it.

positions.description: The flat map: each part's top-left on the canvas.

repo.description: `owner/name` of the repository holding the code, if any.

service.description:
The service this part is, exactly as it emits itself in its telemetry (ADR 0059). No
default: a part without it is never matched to observed traffic.

MapPlacement.description:
Where a `Map:` line places an issue: the part or seam, and the workspace it names, if any
(ADR 0046). On the wire it is a `MapRef` with an optional `workspace`, so an old value reads.

workspace.description: A workspace id: the line places the issue in this workspace only.

MapRef.description: A reference into the system map: a node or a seam. Ids come from `system-map.yml` (ADR 0007).

version.description: Git sha the map was loaded from.

oneOf.description: Owned code with behaviour.
A format or schema others agree on.
Something we stitch, not build.

ORow.description: The 3 am question for one seam: which signal leads back to it, where, and who is woken.

owner.description: Node id of the side that owns the fix.

panel.description: Dashboard panel the signal appears on.

signal.description: Span, metric or log line, with the `rubato.*` attributes it carries.

ObservedTraffic.description:
Observed traffic as the overview carries it (`Overview.traffic`, ADR 0039). Never an input
to progress, pins, plans or approvals.

dismissed.description: Every dismissal in the workspace, whatever the state, so each can be undone.

error.description: Why the last fetch failed, when `failing`.

ghost_edges.description: Calls to or from a ghost. Empty unless `fresh`.

ghosts.description:
Services seen that no part names and that emit a namespace, busiest first. Empty unless
`fresh`; dismissed ones left out.

ghosts_truncated.description: More ghosts or ghost edges were seen than the overview carries.

observed_at.description: When the last good report's window ended.

observed_parts.description: Parts that called or were called in the window. Empty unless `fresh`.

seams.description: Declared seams with calls in the window, in map order. Empty unless `fresh`.

truncated.description: The source cut the report at its edge limit.

undeclared.description: Calls between two parts no seam joins. Empty unless `fresh`.

unmapped_sample.description: Up to 20 of them, sorted. Text only.

unmapped_services.description:
Edge ends in the report with no identity to match: no part names them and they emit no
namespace (ADR 0059).

OpenIssue.description:
An open issue of a repo the map names that Rubato does not track yet: not pinned, launched,
planned or worked on. It has no progress state (ADR 0019).

map_line.description:
The place its body's `Map:` line names, when its author is not trusted to place it
(ADR 0026); a trusted line pins the issue and it leaves this list.

suggestion.description: Where Rubato suggests it belongs. Confirmed by a person, never applied on its own.

OpenPull.description: One open pull request from a branch of the repo itself.

author.description: GitHub login of who opened it.

checks.description: The folded check runs at `head_sha`; absent until they have been read.

issue.description: The issue the branch names (`issue/<n>-…`, ADR 0006), if it names one.

client.description: Interactive or headless (ADR 0062): what the web shows on the lane. Older servers omit it.

connected.description: A websocket is open right now.

PinSuggestion.description:
Where Rubato suggests an unpinned issue belongs, and why. A person confirms it with one
click through the pin route; nothing is pinned by a suggestion.

score.description: 0–100. Only suggestions at or above the server's threshold are sent.

why.description: What matched, in words a person can check: `id web-server in the body`.

approval.description:
The approval record in the front matter, written at handoff (ADR 0054). Absent when the
plan has none of its keys; a record with a key missing is kept as it is, so the check can
report it.

data_models.description:
The tables, types, schemas, events and files the change introduces, changes or removes,
from its `## Data models` table (ADR 0031). Optional; empty when absent or "None."

decisions.description:
The decisions recorded while the plan was drafted, from its `## Decisions` table
(ADR 0056). Optional; empty when absent or "None."

flows.description: What the plan will send across seams, from its `## Flows` table (ADR 0021). Optional.

git_ref.description: Git ref the plan was read from (branch name or commit sha).

path.description: Path of the plan file inside the repository.

PlanApprovalRecord.description:
The approval record a handoff writes into the front matter (ADR 0054): who approved, when, and
the approval hash of the plan they approved. Left out of that hash.

PlanDecision.description: One row of the plan's `## Decisions` table (ADR 0056).

PlanFit.description:
Where a plan fits the map, and whether it does (ADR 0029). An approval counts only while
`fits` is true.

PlanFlow.description:
One row of the plan's Flows table: something the change sends from one part to another over
a seam. The seam must join the two parts.

Position.description: The top-left corner of a part on the map canvas, in the canvas's own units.

Progress.description: Derived progress of one issue, with the time of the newest signal behind it.

blocked_from.description:
The rail station a *Blocked* issue left from (ADR 0043): `started`, `designing`,
`designed` or `building`. Absent for every other state, and when nothing ran (off the
rail). Derived by [`blocked_from`] from the same inputs as `state`; never stored.

reason.description: One line on why, for *Blocked* and *Unknown*.

oneOf.description: Issue exists and is pinned to the map.
Session launched for the issue.
Session working, no plan file yet.
Plan file on the branch; affected nodes lit.
Session working after the plan.
Session blocked (hook) or a cap hit.
PR open, checks green.
Merged.
The signal is not flowing. Trust check first.

Proposal.description: The one proposal there can be. While it exists the draft takes no operations.

oneOf.description: The server is writing the branch and opening the pull request, or a step failed.
The pull request is open.
The pull request was merged; the draft empties once the map has been loaded again.

PullRequestState.description: The pull request for an issue branch.

QueuedIssue.description: One issue waiting on one companion.

last_start_error.description:
Why the latest start from the queue did not start, as the companion reported it. Absent
until a start is refused or fails; the entry stays queued.

queued_by.description: GitHub login of who queued it: the companion's own user.

RepoPulls.description: One map repo's open pull requests and how fresh that listing is.

error.description: Why the last listing failed, when it did; `pulls` are from the last good one.

listed_at.description: When the last listing succeeded; absent until one has.

truncated.description: The last listing hit its one page: there are more than `pulls` shows.

RepoRef.description: A repository behind one or more nodes.

plan_path.description: Plan path template with `{issue}` and `{slug}` placeholders. Default `docs/plans/{issue}.md`.

ReviewRecord.description:
A design review posted as an issue comment, first line `Review: <track> — <outcome>`
(ADR 0027). Only a trusted author's review is kept.

outcome.description: The rest of the first line, e.g. `passed after fixes`.

plan_sha.description: The plan version the review read, when its `Plan` section names one.

Scenario.description:
A named journey: what crosses which seam, in order, when someone uses the system (ADR 0024).
Its id shares the namespace of node and seam ids but is not one a pin or plan may name.

name.description: Short title shown in the scenario picker.

steps.description: In order. Steps need not be contiguous: a journey may jump to another part.

ScenarioStep.description:
One step: a flow declared on `seam`, picked by its kind and direction, and by `carries` when
the seam declares more than one flow with that kind and direction.

carries.description: Must equal the flow's `carries`; required only to tell two such flows apart.

says.description: What happens at this step, in words, for the caption.

Seam.description: A seam between two nodes. The owner side is woken when it breaks.

description.description: What this seam is for, in a sentence a newcomer can read.

flows.description:
What crosses this seam, one entry per thing and direction (ADR 0017). Optional: a seam
without flows is drawn as a plain dependency from `from` to `to`.

guard.description: The check that guards this seam.

owner.description: Node id of the owner side; must be `from` or `to`.

SeamTraffic.description: Calls on one declared seam in the report's window, each way.

forward_calls.description: Calls whose client is the seam's `from` side.

reverse_calls.description: Calls whose client is the seam's `to` side.

ServiceId.description:
A service's identity as it emits it: OpenTelemetry `service.namespace` and `service.name`
(ADR 0059). The namespace is absent only where the emitter has none, as for a servicegraph
virtual node built from a caller's `peer.service`. Rubato never sets or derives it.

SessionState.description: One session as the companion sees it. Identity comes from the branch (ADR 0006).

blocked_by.description:
Which hook blocked the session, with `status = blocked` (ADR 0043). Absent from an
older companion and for a block tmux-ide reported: read as mid-turn.

branch_drift.description:
A launched session that has moved off its launch branch: the branch it is on now. It
keeps its launch issue (its spend cap and telemetry are that issue's); this says so.

hooks_lost.description:
The companion restarted and could not take its old hook port back, so this launched
session's hooks go nowhere: chat and mirroring need a relaunch (plan 122 §D1).

issue.description: Resolved from the branch, or from the launch when the branch does not follow the convention.

launch_id.description: The Rubato launch this session belongs to, when Rubato launched it (ADR 0051).

session_id.description: Claude Code session id, when known.

spend_usd.description: Spend so far, summed from the transcript (A11).

user.description: GitHub login of the paired user.

oneOf.description: No trustworthy signal. Never rendered as working.

SpendPoint.description:
One point of an issue's spend over time: the total over every session it has had, at the
start of a 15-minute span (ADR 0037).

StateSource.description: Where a status came from. Anything not hook-derived is rendered *unknown* (A10).

oneOf.description: A Claude Code hook forwarded by the companion.
tmux-ide state with hook authority (`since` set).
tmux-ide state from screen matching. Not trusted.
The companion just launched it; no event yet.

A headless companion holds the session's turn as its own child process (ADR 0062): the
turn's end, reply and liveness come from that process, not from tmux or hooks. Sent only
to a server that announced `session_stop`.

SystemMap.description: `system-map.yml`. Node and seam ids are the only identifiers pins and plans may use.

owner_rule.description: Prose rule for who owns a seam. Informational.

repos.description: Repositories behind the nodes, with per-repo overrides (ADR 0009).

scenarios.description:
Named journeys through the system, as ordered steps over declared flows (ADR 0024).
Optional; a map without scenarios is still version 1.

TrafficDismissal.description: One dismissal: who dismissed what, and when (ADR 0060). Undo deletes it.

TrafficEnd.description: One end of an observed edge on the overlay: a declared part, or a ghost (ADR 0059).

TrafficState.description: Whether the source can be believed. Only `fresh` draws traffic or makes findings.

oneOf.description: No source is configured.
The last report is recent enough to judge the map by.
No report yet, or the last good one is older than three fetch intervals.
The last fetch failed.

UndeclaredEdge.description: Calls between two map parts that no seam joins.

WorkspaceInfo.description: One workspace as the switcher shows it.

id.description: `[a-z0-9-]{1,32}`: in URLs (`?w=`, `/api/w/{id}`), rows and the `rubato.workspace` attribute.

map_repo.description: `owner/name` of the repo holding this workspace's map.

name.description: What people call it: the entry's `name`, else the map's.

version.description: Git sha of the map as loaded. Absent until it has loaded once.
